description: This file defines the MockHandler class in the AWS SDK for PHP, used for testing purposes to simulate AWS service responses with a queue of predefined results or exceptions.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A mock handler for AWS SDK that returns predefined responses or exceptions, useful for testing network call handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with a queue of results or exceptions, and optional callbacks for fulfillment and rejection.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds one or more ResultInterface objects, Exceptions, or callables to the queue.

methods.name: appendException
methods.description: Adds one or more Exceptions or Throwables to the queue.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a command and request, returning a promise that resolves with the queued result or throws an exception.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining items in the queue.
